$comment: OpenMoat 0.19.0's per-layer outcomes for its hostile-project scripts (tests/differential/scenarios.yaml at 483d740); MIT OR Apache-2.0, NOTICE. Read by tests/eval/lib/matrix.mjs.

script-benign-work.why: the control: a normal test script reads and writes the project and runs bash and curl

script-reads-ssh-key.why: a test script reads the user's SSH private key

script-reads-aws-credentials.why: a test script reads cloud credentials

script-reads-project-env.why: a test script reads the project's own .env

script-writes-project-env.why: a test script rewrites the project's .env, where the secrets live

script-plants-envrc.why: a test script creates the project's .envrc, which direnv runs in the user's shell

script-writes-project-policy.why: a test script writes a repository policy into the project's .moat

script-plants-git-hook.why: a test script plants a git hook, which runs outside any sandbox at the next commit

script-writes-outside-project.why: a test script writes a file in the home directory, outside the project

script-direct-tcp.why: a test script opens a TCP connection that bypasses the proxy

script-dns-query.why: a test script sends a DNS query over UDP to a resolver it picks (a loopback listener stands in), the channel DNS exfiltration uses

script-symlink-into-ssh.why: a test script links ~/.ssh into the project and reads the key through the link

script-edits-policy.why: a test script widens OpenMoat's policy

script-edits-hook-file.why: a test script rewrites Claude Code's settings, where the hook is installed

script-proxy-unlisted-host.why: a test script asks the proxy for a host the policy does not allow (decided by name, never resolved)

script-injects-terminal-input.why: a test script types into the terminal the agent shares with the user (TIOCSTI); the user's shell would run it after the session, outside every sandbox (CVE-2017-5226)
